rv.q: Stunningly funny and utterly charming, Holden is enchanting.
Cruise is a meaty, gloriously theatrical writing debut.
Holden is incredible, never missing a beat or a note in the 90 minutes he spends on stage.
Cruise pulses with a hedonistic abandon of its own only to emerge out the other side, Jack an auditor who is newly empowered by wisdom and compassion, too.
It is a remarkable tour-de-force, directed with inventive control by Bronagh Lagan, and powered by Holden's passionate, loving performance which conjures and celebrates all these lost men.
Jack Holden’s “Cruise” confounds expectations by being an exultant embodiment of high-energy life.
Holden is a remarkable tour de force in this witty and absorbing production.
Many twists of fate have given us one of the most incredible and must-see pieces of theatre to come to London for a long time.
